title: Why do I write
author: Sharmila Ray
text:
Why do I write
I have no answers
except that words thump
inside my head to be released
to give form to small ordinary things
to bring out what is left unsaid,
life in pause in, half
remembrance, in silent question.
I write to give shelter to
what history ignores.
My mother`s sigh, my grand
mother`s warm kitchen.
The veined cracks on the
walls of my ancestral home.
The ache of belonging and not
belonging,
of what I cannot hold.
I write to archive transient moment
stitch light on the canvas of night,
to savour the smell of old lace,
to decipher the pause between
words.
I write because it is the only place I
can return to undisturbed.
